ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon File Created In Office Startup Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of a file with an uncommon extension in an Office application startup folder

sequences.query: (((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Word\\\\STARTUP.*") OR (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Office.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Program\\ Files.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\STARTUP.*"))) AND  NOT ((file_path = RGX("\\\.docb$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.docm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.docx$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dotm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.mdb$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.mdw$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.pdf$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.wll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.wwl$")))) OR ((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Excel\\\\XLSTART.*") OR (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Office.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Program\\ Files.*") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\XLSTART.*"))) AND  NOT ((file_path = RGX("\\\.xll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xls$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xlsm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xlsx$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xlt$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xltm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.xlw$"))))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Shared\\\\ClickToRun\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\OfficeClickToRun\\\.exe$")) OR ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\.*")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\winword\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$"))))
